digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler identity write and recovery path
propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) after create_issue succeeds calls delete_issue on the newly-created Jira issue, destroying recoverable work

After delete_issue is called, the keyed-pending binding is never unbound, leaving a binding that points at a deleted Jira key and strands the local ticket permanently on every subsequent recovery pass

The recovery path recover_pending's KEYED branch already exists to retro-attach identity labels deterministically without search, making the rollback delete redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery

Jira's screen-configuration error messages are misleading: the field may genuinely not be on the Create/Edit screen, or the failure may be due to jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or the value may be malformed on a field that is on the screen

A self-hosted DC instance with a customized Create screen that excludes labels will trigger identity write failure and issue deletion, whereas the Cloud project succeeds because labels is on the screen

The labels field must be declared as a required project configuration rather than pre-flighting with createmeta, following the precedent of Sentry's Jira integration which explicitly does not support custom required fields
